segments.text: Is the gas that makes our electricity secretly sunlight?
Millions of years ago, tiny sea creatures got their energy from the Sun. When they died, they were buried under layers of rock, and slowly turned into natural gas.
Today, Singapore burns that gas to make about ninety-three out of every hundred units of our electricity. So when you switch on a light, you're using very, very old sunlight!
So, is gas power really solar power? Watch the full episode on TheOneApp, Explored.
